page_title: RMA 4-1 PAL | Real Madrid v Las Palmas 19/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Lucas Vazquez as he is replaced by Lorenzo (Real Madrid).
87' The goal by Real Madrid is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
86' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Real Madrid players aren’t happy.

86' Lucas Vazquez looks around to decide who he is going to pass to. He picks out Federico Valverde (Real Madrid), who collects the ball perfectly and unleashes a terrific shot from just outside of the box towards the top left corner and it ricochets in off the post. The score is 5:1.
84' Substitution. Endrick (Real Madrid) replaces Rodrygo.
83' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Chema Andres (Real Madrid) replacing Dani Ceballos.
83' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) squandered a huge opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He blazed it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
80' It will be a substitution. Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) is ready to enter the pitch as Sandro Ramirez walks off.
76' Carlo Ancelotti decides to make a substitution. Antonio Rudiger will be replaced by David Alaba (Real Madrid).
76' The substitution is prepared. Arda Guler (Real Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Brahim Diaz.
76' The goal by Real Madrid won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
75' Wait! Referee Alejandro Quintero has indicated he is going to review the Real Madrid goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
73' Goal! Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) has the simplest of tasks to roll the ball into an empty net from close range after a rebound left the keeper stranded. 5:1.
70' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) will replace Fabio Silva.
64' He’s off! Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) gets his marching orders from referee Alejandro Quintero after the VAR review.

63' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas), but referee Alejandro Quintero must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
62' Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) is very lucky to stay on the pitch after using excessive force to bring down his opponent with a two-footed challenge.
58' Diego Martinez has decided to make a change. Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) replaces Alberto Moleiro.
58' It is time for a substitution. Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) is on for Alex Munoz.
57' 4 - 1 Goal! Fran Garcia shows great vision to find Rodrygo (Real Madrid) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom right corner. 4:1.
57' Great teamplay by Real Madrid as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
51' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.

49' The ball falls kindly for Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
49' Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle for a foul after Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) hacks down one of his opponents.
48' The goalkeeper pulls off a save to deny Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid), whose low effort is only aimed at the middle of the goal.
48' Real Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
48' Real Madrid play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass. Real Madrid earn a corner.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Diego Martinez gives a chance to Benito Ramirez and Juanma Herzog (Las Palmas) is off.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Alejandro Quintero shows a yellow card to Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) for his blatant foul.

45+2' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) received a precise low pass and attempted to surprise the keeper with a quick execution. A superb strike only denied by the right post. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' Celebrations are cut short for Real Madrid as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
43' Celebrations by Real Madrid are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
42' Goal - 4:1! Rodrygo laid the ball off to Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid), who slots it into the back of the net from close range, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
38' The corner is swung in but Real Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
38' Real Madrid are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear. Now Real Madrid have a corner.

36' 3 - 1 Goal! Rodrygo puts Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) in the clear with just the keeper to beat. He takes his shot early from the edge of the box and scores beautifully into the top right corner. 3:1.
33' 2 - 1 Goal! Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) finishes from close range with an easy finish and he makes it 2:1. He was ably assisted there by Lucas Vazquez.
33' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Jasper Cillessen stops the ball from going inside right post.
32' The resulting set piece from Real Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
31' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

30' Jasper Cillessen makes a miraculous save! Rodrygo (Real Madrid) gets to a rebound and attempts to put it into the right side of the target, but the goalkeeper dives to stop his effort. Real Madrid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
30' Real Madrid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
30' Real Madrid are showing great team-chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly but finally one of the defending players makes an interception.

28' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went straight towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
26' Jasper Cillessen makes a brilliant save! Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper low into the middle of the goal.
25' Real Madrid fail to score from a corner as Jasper Cillessen (Las Palmas) leaps to collect the ball.

25' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
22' Dangerous play by Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid). Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle for a foul.
18' 1 - 1 Goal! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Jasper Cillessen to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
18' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is going to take the penalty!
17' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. It's a penalty for Real Madrid!
14' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Las Palmas.
13' Alex Munoz (Las Palmas) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Las Palmas.
12' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
12' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) brings his opponent down. Alejandro Quintero has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
9' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Las Palmas comes to nothing.
9' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Las Palmas force their opponents to concede a corner.
8' Real Madrid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

8' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top left corner, but Jasper Cillessen has it covered and makes a comfortable save. Real Madrid will take a corner kick.
5' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) brings an opponent down and Alejandro Quintero interrupts the game.
5' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort just past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
3' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
1' 0 - 1 Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) gets on the end of a long pass that is slotted through the defence and easily sends the ball into the bottom left corner!
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Las Palmas will have the kick-off.
Alejandro Quintero will referee today's match.
